mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 700K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling a supply chain rebound, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% in a quarter, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 3-month moving average, signaling labor market weakness, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 3mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, indicating strong consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of holiday season instances when RSAFS > 12mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
